Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Anurag Verma, learned A.G.A. and perused
the record.

2.  The present application has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in FIR No.15 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Mahanagar, District Lucknow Commissionerate.
3. In terms of the FIR, allegations were levelled that the daughter of the informant was marriage to the brother of the applicant in July, 2021 and sufficient dowry was also given.

allegations were levelled against the entire matrimonial family for causing the death of the daughter of the informant.
The postmortem report on record indicates the cause of death as ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark, no other injury was visible on the body of the deceased.
The co-accused husband has been granted regular bail vide order dated 09.05.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.4920 of 2024.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.4920 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant is the brother of the husband of the deceased and is serving in Indian Army and there being no specific allegations against the applicant of causing the injury to the deceased soon before the death in relation to demand of dowry.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.
5. Considering the aforesaid facts, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for the benefit of anticipatory bail.
Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

6. In the event of arrest, let the applicantAmit Kumar Chaudhari be released on anticipatory bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer concerned with the following conditions:

( i) The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) The applicant shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer and (iii) The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court.
